admission.justification: Prevents silently spending an obsolete hard-coded review budget, losing recorded allowance history or admitting a record-only/wording claim beyond its actual boundary.

applicability: Supported direct-record projections of absent or legacy review limits.
conditions: A zero stored limit is pre-limit absence; resolved settings and existing extras supply the effective value.
exclusions: Positive stored post-limit values are not silently rewritten by direct-record.
Unreadable settings refuse recording. Removed task_doc get/read_steps provide no supported answer route.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_review_state.py (backfill proofs); mcp/tests/test_task_doc_review_public.py (legacy get, direct record); evidence-attempt3/focused-pytest.log

statement: Supported direct-record answers carry the effective settings number plus approved extra rounds; a stored zero means the record predates limits, never a zero-round budget.
